indicator.name: Disability prevalence
indicator.description: Share of the population identified as having a disability under the published 2019 KPHC Washington Group Short Set threshold.
indicator.expected_source: KNBS 2019 KPHC Analytical Report on Disability, Table 2.13
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published directly for all 47 counties in Table 2.13. Census observation; no survey uncertainty requirement and no lower-level inheritance.
